'''Bitt Panith's secret base''' was a laboratory located on the [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Akoshissss]]. There the Muun cyberneticist, [[Bitt Panith]], designed new armor for [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]] and created a cyborg monster that was immune to [[the Force]] named [[Krossen]].

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Galactic Senate sent [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]], [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|her Padawan]], [[Jaylen Kos]], and [[Clone Sergeant|clone sergeant]], [[Lex (clone trooper)|Lex]], along with [[Eighteenth Battalion|the Eighteenth Battalion]] to the moon of Akoshissss where Krossen was in the final stages of development. During [[Battle of Akoshissss|the battle]] that ensued, the Jedi and Lex went on a mission to infiltrate Bitt Panith's laboratory. Once inside, Jaylen and Lex destroyed Krossen, and Eerin arrested the Muun, who was then taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he stood trial for his crimes.
